title: Find the Largest Almost Missing Integer
summary: Given an integer array and a size k, identify the largest integer that appears in exactly one subarray of size k.
statement: Given an integer array and a size k, identify the largest integer that appears in exactly one subarray of size k. If no such integer exists, return -1. A subarray consists of consecutive elements within the array.
constraints: Consider every contiguous subarray of length k.
A value is almost missing when it occurs in exactly one such subarray, regardless of repetitions inside that subarray.
Return the largest almost-missing value, or -1 if none exists.
hints: Track in how many windows each distinct value appears.
Use a set per window so repetition inside one window counts once.
Select values whose window count is exactly one.
Taking their maximum, with -1 as default, gives the required result.
editorial: Taking their maximum, with -1 as default, gives the required result.

tests.explanation: Values three and seven each appear in one length-three window; seven is larger.
One occurs in both windows, so no value qualifies.
